g.text: GENERAL TRANSLATION in Anybody (anybody-150-900.woff2) at size 100 on the baseline y 0, cap height 67.5 (capHeight 1350 of 2000 units in anybody-150-900.woff2), so its cap line is at y −67.5 (Prototemplate scripts/build/speed-marks.mjs).

Two cuts in a mask, each 0.07 of the cap height high (4.725, written 4.7), centred 0.4 and 0.6 of the cap height below the cap line, at y −40.5 and −27; the mask's rectangles are written from y −42.9 and −29.4.

The E's stem is 566 and its bars 362, 336 and 362 of 2000 units from the baseline up: 28.3, and 18.1, 16.8 and 18.1. Its middle bar lies under the two cuts, so its edges are drawn from the path where the mask hides them. The A and N diagonals are the font's shapes and are left out.

Of the letters' level edges the cap line, the baseline, the cuts and the E's bar edges are drawn; where another letter has an edge at one of those heights it is drawn too: the R's and the T's at −49.4 and the L's at −18.1. The other letters' crossbars, bowls and counters are the font's shapes and are left out.

The letters' edges and the widths between them carry the font's values: each glyph's outline in font units × size / unitsPerEm, placed as type() places it; the path writes them to one decimal (−42.25 is written −42.2).
